Card Q&A.q: Do I have to activate this card's [When Attacking] effect every time I attack with it?
If I use this card's [When Attacking] effect to play a Digimon card with an [On Play] effect, does that [On Play] effect activate when the Digimon enters play?

Effect: [On Play] If you have 3 or fewer security cards, trigger ＜Recovery +2 (Deck)＞. (Place the top 2 cards of your deck on top of your security stack.)
[When Attacking] You may play 1 yellow level 3 Digimon card from your hand without paying its memory cost.
